facts.fact: Tunisia's communications technologies ministry said the G-Cloud and N-Cloud labelling system implements Decree-Law 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 and the minister's decision of 13 September 2023 setting the procedures and conditions for awarding the labels.

The National Cybersecurity Agency awarded the government cloud (G-Cloud) label to Standard Sharing Software (3S) and EO Data Center in July 2024, after Next Step IT received the first N-Cloud label in April 2024.
The article states Tunisia's National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCS) awards the N-Cloud and G-Cloud labels under Decree-Law 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 on cybersecurity.
EO Data Center received the G-Cloud label in July 2024 as a Tunisian hosting provider supplying cloud services to public structures.

TUN.note: The platform is named only as a connection requirement for G-Cloud providers; its operation and links are not stated.

facts.fact: The article says the G-Cloud and N-Cloud labelling system, part of the national digital strategy 2025, aims to guarantee digital sovereignty and build a sovereign cloud offer; G-Cloud providers must connect to the integrated administration network and the national interoperability platform.

TUN.note: Only a general reference to international cybersecurity standards as a label condition; no standards body or named standard.

facts.fact: EO Data Center received the G-Cloud label in July 2024, a label open only to Tunisian hosting providers.
The label is awarded to Tunisian hosting providers of the public or private sector; EO Data Center received it.

TUN.note: Start-ups mentioned only as general beneficiaries of cloud.
